WPSS No. 835 of 2019 
Hon’ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Mr. M.C. Pant, Advocate for the 
petitioner. 
Mr. Aditya Pratap Singh, Advocate for 
respondent no. 1. 
Mr. Lalit Samant, Advocate for 
respondent no. 2. 
Learned counsel for the respondents 
pray for and are granted four weeks’ time for 
filing counter affidavit. 
List this matter on 30.05.2019. 
Learned counsel for the petitioner 
submits that petitioner had made 
representation claiming equal pay for equal 
work but the same has not been decided so 
far. 
 If that is so, Member Secretary, 
Uttarakhand Pollution Control Board shall 
consider the representation filed by the 
petitioner claiming equal pay for equal work 
and pass appropriate order in accordance 
with law within four weeks from today. 
Learned counsel for respondent no. 1 
submits that though recently requisition has 
been sent to the selecting body for holding 
selection, but selection process is not going 
to be concluded in near future.

Navin 10.04.2019

Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. Rajendra Dobhal, learned senior counsel 
assisted by Mr. Shubhang Dobhal, learned counsel for 
the appellants.
2. Mr. M.C. Pant, learned counsel for the appellant 
in the connected matter.
3. Mr. Pradeep Hairiya, learned Standing Counsel 
for the State.
4. Mr. Aditya Pratap Singh, learned counsel for the 
respondents.
5. The petitioners are working since last more than 
10-15 years on contractual basis praying for 
regularization. Respondent department is the State 
Pollution Control Board.
6. Now, taking into consideration that petitioners 
are working since last more than 10 to 15 years the 
respondent should adopt a criteria by one time 
measure for treating their contractual appointment as a 
substantive appointment by constituting a selection 
committee by holding a test as prescribed.
7. On this aspect, let Mr. Aditya Pratap Singh may 
get instructions by 22.12.2025.
8. List this matter on 22.12.2025.
 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
 16.12.2025
